title: Make ga5_resignation_childname_test.dart exercise the real manage_grants/decline_invite call sites it claims to guard

evidence.quote: 'manage_grants notification call passes childDisplayLabel not childProfileId',

why: This file only imports tutor_grant_aggregate.dart — it never imports or pumps manage_grants_screen.dart or decline_invite_screen.dart. Tests named 'manage_grants notification call passes childDisplayLabel not childProfileId' and 'broken call site passes raw id — this is the bug' actually just call hand-written local proxy functions (_brokenChildNameArg/_fixedChildNameArg) that are trivially defined to return grant.childProfileId or grant.childDisplayLabel respectively — they always pass regardless of what the real screens do. The real bug was fixed correctly (verified: manage_grants_screen.dart:260 and decline_invite_screen.dart:130 both now pass childDisplayLabel), but if a future refactor of either screen's notification call reintroduces the raw-id bug, this regression suite — despite its name and its docstring framing 'this is the bug'/'this is the fix' — would not catch it.
recommendation: Either widget-pump the real screens and assert on the captured notification args (as the other test files in this batch do via mocktail captureAny), or rename/rescope the tests to be honest that they only pin the domain-model contract, not the call sites.
acceptance_criteria: at least one test in this file pumps the real manage_grants_screen.dart or decline_invite_screen.dart and verifies (via mocktail capture) that notifyParentOfResignation/notifyParentOfDecline receives childDisplayLabel
reverting the fix in manage_grants_screen.dart or decline_invite_screen.dart locally makes this suite fail
